item.title: A Day Trip to Chimgan
item.summary: A young man tells the story of a Saturday trip to the mountains with his friends.
item.transcript_text: Last Saturday, my friends and I went on a day trip to Chimgan, in the mountains near Tashkent. We left very early, at six o'clock, because we wanted to miss the traffic. When we arrived, the air was cold and fresh, and there was still some snow on the mountain tops. First, we walked up a hill for about an hour. It was hard work, but the view from the top was amazing. We could see the whole valley and a lake far below. Then we had a picnic with bread, cheese, tomatoes and hot tea. In the afternoon, my friend Bekzod wanted to take the cable car, but it was closed because of the strong wind. We were a bit disappointed, so we played football instead. We got home at eight in the evening, tired but very happy.
